description: Starkregengefahrenkarte - Jüchen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The heavy rain hazard maps of the city of Jüchen represent the precipitation load of the city area for various heavy rain events, including a 30th and a 100th. Annual rain event. The purpose of these maps is to show citizens which locations, streets and even individual houses are particularly affected by heavy rain events. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Heavy rain hazard map - Jüchen" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Starkregen, Jüchen, Wasser, Überflutung, Wasserhöhen. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
